Again, I'm not staff and this is just wild speculation.

item.title: Re: just out of curiosity?
item.content:encoded:
cant they just neutralize her by telling her she's a completely normal girl and has lost all power she originally had.

Nope, because it's powered on her beliefs. All you'd do is cripple any conscious control she has of of her abilities. As mentioned in the article, she created a real Santa Claus because someone told her he was real. It doesn't matter if she does or does not believe herself capable of performing "magic"; if someone told her that Godzilla was real and she believed it, Tokyo would be shortly attacked afterwards by a giant atomic-breathing lizard thing that looks like giant guy in a big rubber suit.

item.content:encoded:
So, I realized something slightly alarming based on the following facts:

  • SCP-239 can be damaged via telekill alloy.
  • SCP-239 was able to manipulate Clef on some level.
  • SCP-239 forces what she thinks on reality, not what she wants.
  • SCP-239 has no real classification on the reality-warping scale, both the GOC version and the Foundation's version.

I could go on but none of these things are normal for reality bending humans, what if it isn't a reality warping human? Then it makes perfect sense for what it thinks to become real. If this elder-thing thinks grass is purple then yeah it's gonna make grass purple.

Another thing people seem to be glossing over is what the fuck is telekill? There's something the Foundation isn't telling us about.

item.content:encoded:
This was one of the first articles I ever read when I first learned about the site. To this day 239 has been one of my favorite SCPs. But this article hasn't aged very well and while I don't want it to be deleted, I do think that it needs a rewrite.

I still love the core concept of this article. A person with the ability to reshape reality without any limit but restrained by her own innocence and an elaborate lie could be really interesting. But the article doesn't flow very well and it doesn't do much with the concept aside from one or two instances. Her making the D class disappear was just kind of there. The part about her admitting a special kind of wave was not explored near enough.

The part with her creating Santa and the Foundation unable to contain him because she believes that he can't be caught was cool. If the article was composed of more stuff like that it would be so much better. As it is the article feels like its wasting so much potential.
